info.name: GownApi
info.description:
Tests for every endpoint in GownApi.

**Run order:** 00 Auth -> 01/02 (read-only, safe) -> 03 (writes test data) -> 04 (negative). Folder 05 has external side effects and is skipped unless you set its variables.

Select the `GownApi - Local` environment and set `username` / `password` first.

item.name: 00 Auth

request.description: Logs in with `username`/`password` from the environment and stores the JWT in the `token` collection variable used by every other request.

exec: pm.test('Body has token, role, name', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); ['token', 'role', 'name'].forEach(k => pm.expect(b, k).to.have.property(k)); });

request.description: 200 when the logged-in user has the `manager` role, 403 otherwise.

exec: pm.test('Body has valid', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); ['valid'].forEach(k => pm.expect(b, k).to.have.property(k)); });
